title: fix(edm): add wire tool kind and gate EDM tool UI visibility
body:
## What changed
- Added `ToolKind::Wire` (`"wire"` / `"EDM wire"`), non-spinning (`rpm == 0`, `corner_r == 0`, diameter in `[0.02, 1.0]` mm, no cutting-data rows), `tool-wire.svg`/`tool-wire.png`, and catalog entry `"EDM-W025"` (`0.25` mm brass wire).
- Changed `OpType::WireContour` (`tool_law::WIRE`) to mount a `ToolKind::Wire` library tool (`mounts_tool() == true`).
- Changed `wire_op::condition_of` and `wire_op::one_condition` to read `wire_diameter` from the mounted `ToolKind::Wire` tool, require `ConditionField::Gap`, enforce agreement against `edm.wire_diameters` and any condition-stated `wire_diameter` within `WIRE_MATCH_MM`, and refuse `gap >= wire_diameter * 0.5`.
- Updated `collect_job`, `current_stamp`, `stale_reason`, operation commands (`create`, `paste`, `edit`, `retype`, `retarget`), `setup_sheet`, `cutting`, `posting`, `stock_sim`, `project::validate`, and UI quick-add / tool settings to mount and validate `ToolKind::Wire`.
- Added `machine_modes::tool_kind_offered` and filtered Tool Library catalog, Tool type filter, and New Tool dropdown so a tool kind appears only when at least one `KindInfo` entry accepts it and admits a selectable `MACHINE_MODES` entry or mounted machine.
- Recorded architectural rationale in `docs/decisions/2011-edm-wire-tool.md`.

## Cause
`OpType::WireContour` previously used `tk::NO_TOOL`, leaving Wire EDM users with no selectable wire tool in the catalog or operation Tool row while storing wire diameter only inside machine `.mch` condition rows. Meanwhile, the Tool Library and New Tool dropdown listed every `ToolKind` unconditionally, exposing `Sinker electrode` / `"EDM-E10X6"` even while `Kind::SinkerEdm` is absent from `MACHINE_MODES`.

## Tests
- **Pins (red before fix, green after)**:
  - `camcraft-app --test wire_tool`: `wire_contour_mounts_a_wire_tool_and_catalog_lists_one` failed on `upstream/main` (`af83da0`); now all 5 tests in `wire_tool` pass (refusals on bad rpm/diameter/corner/cutting rows, kerf & NC path shifting on wire tool edit with stamp staleness, machine/condition/skim/tab-cutoff/spark-gap mismatch checks).
  - `camcraft-ui --lib edm_tool_visibility`: `sinker_electrode_is_hidden_when_sinker_edm_is_not_selectable_and_wire_is_offered` failed on `upstream/main` (`EDM-E10X6` visible without `SinkerEdm`); now both tests pass (`EDM-E10X6` and `Sinker electrode` stay hidden without `SinkerEdm`, reveal together when a custom `sinker_edm` `.mch` mounts, and `EDM-W025` / `"EDM wire"` work end-to-end).
- **Mutation checks (red when mutated, green when restored)**:
  - Reverted `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_library.rs` to `upstream/main`: `edm_tool_visibility` failed (`EDM-E10X6` exposed); restored passes.
  - Bypassed `TOOL_KINDS` filter in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings.rs`: `edm_tool_visibility` failed (`Sinker electrode` offered); restored passes.
  - Bypassed `crates/tools/src/wire.rs::refusal`: `wire_tool` failed (`BadRpm` accepted); restored passes.
  - Bypassed each guard in `crates/app/src/operation/wire_op.rs` (`edm.wire_diameters` check, `c.wire_diameter` match check, and `gap >= wire_diameter * 0.5` check): `wire_tool` failed on each guard independently; restored passes.
- **Gate & Lint**:
  - `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed. Including `camcraft-ui` is blocked by the upstream `short_caption` match missing `Waterjet` (E0004).
  - `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: RED on the upstream UI `Waterjet` compile error. Tools passed (6s), all 281 app binaries passed (992s), UI compilation failed (74s); no UI gate tests ran.
  - `cargo test -p xtask icons`: passed (7 passed, 0 failed).

## Goldens moved
None (`git diff --stat upstream/main -- "*.nc" "*.cl"` is empty).
(`wire_stamp::ONE_PROFILE_STAMP` moved to digest the mounted `EDM-W025` tool alongside `stamp_condition`.)

## Not exercised
- `cargo xtask gate release` pixel-snapshot suites.
- Physical Wire EDM or Sinker EDM machine cutting tests.

## Overlaps
No open PR modifies the same functions or lines. These open PRs touch some of the same files in different functions or lines (whichever merges second refreshes):
- #2077 (`file.rs`, `edit.rs`, `state.rs`)
- #2092 (`file.rs`, `tool_settings.rs`)
- #2126 (`file.rs`, `kinds.rs`)
- #2125 (`machine_wire_edm.rs`)
- #2110 (`catalog_asset.rs`)
- #2090 (`tool_icons.rs`)
- #2048, #1821 (`create.rs`, `edit.rs`)
- #1817, #2093, #2037 (`edit.rs`, `gates.rs`, `kinds.rs`)
- #1921 (`wire_verify.rs`)
- #1713 (`kinds.rs`)
- #1798 (`icons.rs`, `state.rs`)
- #1738 (`state.rs`)
- #1330 (`state.rs`, held)
- #1753 (adds `SinkerEdm` to `MACHINE_MODES`, no shared lines — unblocks `Sinker electrode` visibility once merged)

## Latest review fixes

Head: `4a9c638436bbd3e6f4a86907f4c3a4a8e7a27c4c`. Merged upstream main `57f2ffbbf` cleanly before applying the fixture fix.

- Legacy Wire Contours with empty tool references now open in a recovery state. Their saved machine condition and wire diameter remain unchanged. Cached paths and generation stamps are cleared, and a load note requests a wire tool. Generation and posting refuse until a valid tool is explicitly assigned. Pinned by `wire_tool::legacy_wire_project_opens_without_a_tool_and_requires_recovery_before_posting`, including successful posting after explicit recovery.
- `wire_verify_tol` mounts `EDM-W025` and retains its tolerance, posting, and project assertions. Both tests pass.
- Reverting validation, removing recovery, retaining the stamp, retaining the cache, and restoring the empty-tool fixture each made its pin RED; each restoration was GREEN.
- The existing `edm_tool_visibility` tests pass. Bypassing catalog filtering and New Tool filtering independently made them RED, and restoring each filter returned GREEN. Before/after screenshots are linked below.

## UI before and after

These are actual 1600 × 1200 egui shell renders. Before uses the pre-change parent `af83da0f4`; after uses reviewed head `b20b3d30b`. A temporary test harness opened the same Tool library and New Tool views. No source workaround was needed. The captures live only on the fork’s images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.

Before has no wire tool, so its controls show the default End mill. After shows the EDM wire controls with 0.25 mm wire diameter and no spindle RPM or corner radius. The catalog and type menus show EDM wire becoming available and Sinker electrode being hidden when its machine kind is unavailable.

| View | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| EDM catalog entries | ![Before EDM catalog entries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d1508b4e702e5796a68a854cc4900d8a48e79b5c/2140/catalog-before.png) | ![After EDM catalog entries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d1508b4e702e5796a68a854cc4900d8a48e79b5c/2140/catalog-after.png) |
| Catalog type choices | ![Before Catalog type choices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d1508b4e702e5796a68a854cc4900d8a48e79b5c/2140/catalog-types-before.png) | ![After Catalog type choices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d1508b4e702e5796a68a854cc4900d8a48e79b5c/2140/catalog-types-after.png) |
| New Tool type choices | ![Before New Tool type choices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d1508b4e702e5796a68a854cc4900d8a48e79b5c/2140/tool-types-before.png) | ![After New Tool type choices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d1508b4e702e5796a68a854cc4900d8a48e79b5c/2140/tool-types-after.png) |
| Tool controls | ![Before Tool controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d1508b4e702e5796a68a854cc4900d8a48e79b5c/2140/tool-controls-before.png) | ![After Tool controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d1508b4e702e5796a68a854cc4900d8a48e79b5c/2140/tool-controls-after.png) |

Changelog: Add wire tool kind (`EDM-W025`) mounted on Wire Contour operations and hide UI tool kinds whose machine kind is unavailable.
Fixes #2011
